biography.plain_text: Antonio Pulcini is an Italian property developer who founded Gruppo Pulcini in 1964. From early apartment schemes around Rome, he built an integrated business that acquires sites, designs, constructs, sells, leases and manages residential, commercial, healthcare and tourism properties. The family group also developed Poltu Quatu, a hotel-and-marina resort on Sardinia's Costa Smeralda.

confidence.reason: Gruppo Pulcini's official chronology establishes the founding date, Rome projects and integrated property functions, while the official Poltu Quatu source independently documents Pulcini's founder role and development of the Sardinian resort.

long_biography.plain_text:
Gruppo Pulcini's operating model keeps each property stage inside the business. Its teams analyse markets, acquire sites, design, build, sell, lease and manage residential, commercial, healthcare and tourism developments. That breadth gave Antonio Pulcini a platform for retaining completed assets while continuing to originate new projects.

Pulcini framed construction as a way to create modern places for people to live, work and receive care. The published project record moves from apartment blocks and offices to shopping centres, hospitals and large residential districts. In Rome, the group's design studies treat archaeological recovery as part of urban development, integrating historic remains into new structures.

uncertainties.detail: No sufficiently authoritative source established Antonio Pulcini's exact place or date of birth. Italian nationality and the Rome-based business are not used to infer a birthplace, so all birth fields remain unproposed.

Public sources establish that Pulcini founded and built the core business but do not describe his family finances, launch capital or pre-business platform. The broader Self-made classification is therefore used instead of an unsupported independent or advantaged subtype.

The official group page contains dated project volumes and investment forecasts, while current public material confirms a continuing private family property group without a consolidated cap table or current valuation. The dossier classifies the evidenced sector and founder relationship without importing stale figures or a present ownership percentage.

Antonio Pulcini is the founder and historic president; official material identifies his son Daniele as chief executive and head of the family group. The known-for title therefore uses the durable founder relationship rather than implying continuing daily management.

No personal LinkedIn, Instagram or website met the identity-verification standard. The Pulcini Group LinkedIn page is used only as a company source and is not proposed as a personal LinkedIn profile; only the official company website is proposed under its distinct type.

Politics, legal disputes, allegations, controversies, volatile wealth and portfolio figures, private family information beyond documented business succession, and all vessel-specific information are excluded from the biographies.
